records.statement: lemma lemma_inner (n : ℕ) (a b c x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (h₂ : 3 • c = 4 • b - a) : 3 * inner ℝ x c = 4 * inner ℝ x b - inner ℝ x a
records.proof:
by
  have h_congr := congrArg (fun v => inner ℝ x v) h₂
  simp only [inner_smul_right, inner_sub_right] at h_congr
  exact h_congr
